title: 第十二章 脉络清晰第十三章 大黑天神掌
slug: 灭门夜我易筋经大圆满
content_zh:
一本【黑煞魔功】通篇不过区区两千言。
两个人很快就已经将其看完了一遍。
对视一眼之后，发现这东西果然不愧是魔功。
内功修炼的方法，简单粗暴，却又剑走偏锋。
修炼这门武功，需要借女子鲜血，是想要汲取血液之中的先天元阴。
选择的女子最基础的要求，是要处子之身。
再好一点，便是阴年出生，更佳者阴年阴月，一直到周青梅所了解的上品。
为了保证先天元阴不失，所以修炼这门武功，不能杀人放血。
而是要趁着人还活着的时候，在百会穴开一个小孔，将掌心劳宫穴和百会穴相抵，按照魔功秘法引先天元阴入体，从手厥阴心包经，转入任脉气海。
一直到女子身死，先天元阴彻底消散为止。
其后便要将这阴气，化为黑煞真气。
从此运走周天，待等内功积累深厚，再打通任督二脉，这门魔功就算是大成了。
此法简单之处在于，只要先天元阴足够，内力积蓄的速度远不是江湖上这些名门正派的内功所能相提并论。
而黑煞真气又阴毒狠辣，坏人根基，损人修为，非常棘手。
“倒也难怪，当年黑煞教能够横行一时。”
方书文看完之后，皱了皱眉头
“而且这里面还没有什么像样的外功武学，白看了。”
“那毁了吧。”
周青梅对这类武功，更是厌恶到了极致。
既然找不到方书文想要的，当即就提出毁去。

方书文也没有犹豫，把这秘籍拿在掌心，内息一转，两手一措，就将其化为了漫天碎屑。
一甩手，将其洒出树洞之外，瞬间湮灭于漫天大雨之中。
周青梅见此松了口气，笑着说道
“其实，你想要找外功武学的话，也不需要从【黑煞魔功】里找。
“我这里就有啊。”
“珠玑阁的武功，能够外传？”
方书文不信。
别说珠玑阁这样的大门大派了，就算是他们四海武馆的武功，若是有人偷师，他们师兄弟也会成帮结队的去找那人麻烦。
最好的处理方法，就是将其拉入武馆，成为学徒。
再不然，就得痛揍一顿，甚至要挑断手筋脚筋。
不是四海武馆的人心狠手辣，这本就是武馆的立身之本，偷学武功乃是江湖大忌，遇到这种情况，把偷学武功的人直接打死都是理所当然。
“珠玑阁的武功当然不能外传，但是我游历江湖，也有一些机遇。”
周青梅说道
“先前我曾经失足跌落一处山洞，在山洞里发现了一套掌法，玄妙万方，极其了得。
“我这一身武功修为都在剑上，珠玑阁的【千字剑法】我尚未领悟完全，自然不会耗费心思在其他武功上面。
“所以这套掌法我一直没练过，你要是想学的话，我可以把这套掌法传授给你。”
“这……”
方书文有些犹豫。
天上没有掉馅饼的好事，周青梅提出这一点的原因，方书文能够理解一些。
但是总感觉如此一来，两个人的关系会变得有些复杂。

原本是最简单的利益关系，周半城花钱让自己保护，自己只要保护好她，事情结束之后，结算奖励，此后一拍两散，再无瓜葛。
虽然说周青梅是个少见的大美女，可越是这样的女人，方书文越是不想去招惹。
毕竟这样长相的姑娘，身边的是非总是很多。
如今若是再得她一套掌法，还是一套能够让珠玑阁真传弟子都极尽赞美的掌法。
content_en:
The entire book [Black Demonic Art] is only two thousand words long.
The two of them had finished reading it quickly.
After looking at each other, they realized that this thing was indeed a magic power.
The method of internal strength cultivation is simple and crude, but also eccentric.
To practice this martial art, you need to borrow the blood of women, in order to absorb the innate Yuan Yin in the blood.
The most basic requirement for the woman you choose is to be a virgin.
Even better, he was born in a yin year, or even better, he was born in a yin year and yin month, all the way up to the top grade that Zhou Qingmei understood.
In order to ensure that the innate Yuan Yin is not lost, so when practicing this martial art, you cannot kill people or let out blood.
Instead, while the person is still alive, make a small hole in the Baihui acupoint, align the Laogong acupoint and Baihui acupoint in the palm of the hand, and guide the innate Yuan Yin into the body according to the secret method of magic power, from the hand Jueyin pericardial meridian to the sea of ​​Ren meridian qi.
Until the woman dies and the innate Yuan Yin completely dissipates.
Afterwards, this Yin Qi will be turned into Black Evil Qi.
From then on, Zhou Tian was transported away, and when the inner strength was accumulated deeply, and then the two channels of Ren and Du were opened, this magical skill would be considered complete.
The simplicity of this method is that as long as the innate Yuan Yin is sufficient, the speed of internal energy accumulation is far beyond what can be compared with the internal energy of these famous sects in the world.
However, the Black Evil Qi is vicious and cruel, bad for people's foundation, and harmful to people's cultivation, which is very difficult to deal with.
"It's no wonder that the Black Evil Sect was able to run rampant back then."
After reading it, Fang Shuwen frowned.
"And there's no decent external martial arts here, so it's all in vain."
"Then destroy it."
Zhou Qingmei hated this kind of martial arts to the extreme.
Since he couldn't find what Fang Shuwen wanted, he immediately proposed to destroy it.
Fang Shuwen did not hesitate. He took the secret book in his palm, turned his inner breath and moved his hands, turning it into debris.
With a wave of his hand, he sprinkled it out of the tree hole and was instantly annihilated in the heavy rain.
Seeing this, Zhou Qingmei breathed a sigh of relief and said with a smile
"Actually, if you want to find external martial arts, you don't need to look for it from [Heisha Demonic Kung Fu].
"I have it right here. "
"Can the martial arts of Zhuji Pavilion be passed on to others? "
Fang Shuwen didn't believe it.
Not to mention a big sect like Zhuji Pavilion, even if someone steals the martial arts from their Sihai Martial Arts School, their brothers will go into groups to find that person and cause trouble.
The best way to deal with it is to drag him into a martial arts gym and become an apprentice.
Otherwise, he would have to be beaten severely, or even have his hand and hamstrings cut off.
It’s not that the people in Sihai Martial Arts School are ruthless, this is the foundation of the martial arts school. Learning martial arts secretly is a taboo in the world. In this case, it is natural to beat the person who learns martial arts secretly to death.
"Of course Zhuji Pavilion's martial arts cannot be passed on to others, but I have traveled around the world and have had some opportunities. "
Zhou Qingmei said
"I once lost my footing and fell into a cave. I discovered a set of palm techniques in the cave. It was mysterious and extremely amazing.
"My martial arts cultivation is all about the sword. I haven't fully understood Zhuji Pavilion's [Thousand-Character Sword Technique] yet, so naturally I won't waste my time on other martial arts.
"So I have never practiced this palm technique. If you want to learn it, I can teach you this palm technique. "
"This..."
Fang Shuwen hesitated.
There is no such thing as a pie in the sky. Fang Shuwen can understand why Zhou Qingmei raised this point.
But it always feels like this makes the relationship between the two people a little complicated.
It was originally the simplest relationship of interest. Zhou Bancheng paid me to protect her. As long as I protect her, after the matter is over, the reward will be settled. From then on, they will be separated and there will be no further involvement.
Although Zhou Qingmei is a rare beauty, the more she is, the less Fang Shuwen wants to mess with her.
After all, a girl with such a look always has a lot of trouble around her.
Now, if she can get another palm technique from her, it will still be a palm technique that will be highly praised by the true disciples of Zhuji Pavilion.
